scenario: AITA for massaging my guy friend in front of his girlfriend? | I (32F) met my friend (30M) at work last year. I'm scared I made her mad, even if she was super nice to me the rest of the evening, I find myself completely stupid for not realising it would be super awkward. By the way, I'm dating someone else and I often tell them about my dates and all, so there is absolutely no ambiguity between me & him, and I always see them together, they're a package and I love it. Was I being an asshole here?
